notes.cache_behavior: Cache is in-process Python dict (no Redis), resets on backend restart. TTL=60s. Cache stats show hits/misses/sets/invalidations/size/namespaces.
notes.gzip_verification: GZip tested against localhost:8001 to avoid K8s ingress header rewriting. Compression confirmed working.
notes.cache_control_verification: Cache-Control headers tested against localhost:8001. Headers correctly set by FastAPI app.
notes.image_attributes_note: Seed data uses PlanetOrb/CrewAvatar fallbacks when no image URLs provided. Image attributes verified in source code (PageHeader.jsx, CasesGrid.jsx, CrewGrid.jsx, BlogPage.jsx).
notes.test_script_issues: 4 backend test failures are due to test script using wrong endpoint paths or expecting wrong response formats. These are NOT bugs in the application.
notes.email_provider: Mock provider still default (from Phase 12) - writes to email_outbox collection only
notes.mongodb_indexes: Text indexes created for bilingual search (title.id/title.en/body.id/body.en) on cms_services, cms_cases, cms_blog, cms_careers. Status indexes on crm_leads.
notes.performance_impact: Cache reduces database queries for public content. GZip reduces bandwidth. Indexes speed up queries. No breaking changes to existing functionality.
